sources.entry: 5118 SEO Wizard - Article generation for engine rankings. 105 #free

summary.one_liner: 5118 is a Chinese SEO and big-data tool platform offering keyword mining, industry keyword libraries, site-group weight monitoring, keyword ranking tracking and trending-word lists for Baidu search.
use_cases: find long-tail search keywords for Chinese websites
track weight changes of websites and subdomains
spot trending words on Baidu and Douyin
summary.what_it_does: The page is the 5118 dashboard and describes a Baidu-focused SEO platform for ranking staff. It offers keyword mining, industry keyword libraries, index and traffic keyword mining, and site-group weight and keyword ranking monitoring. The homepage shows data-update stats such as a total long-tail keyword count (790.29 亿) and monitored subdomain count, plus leaderboards of Baidu weight gains and drops by site. It also lists trending-word boards for Baidu PC, mobile, Toutiao and Douyin. The page text itself is mostly a dashboard with little explanation of how the tools work.
notable: Baidu-focused keyword and ranking data with a long-tail keyword total of 790.29 亿
Trending word boards covering Baidu PC, mobile, Toutiao and Douyin
caveats: Page text does not state pricing or whether any features are paid
Chinese-language interface; the listing's article-generation description is not shown on this page
